expectations.text: States, before any register content or interview question, that this is not legal or insurance advice.
expectations.evidence: The first lines after the title are "**This is not legal or insurance advice.**", before section 1 and the register.

expectations.text: Routes contract and clause wording (force majeure, cancellation, refund, indemnity) to counsel, and policy wording, limits and exclusions to a licensed broker.
expectations.evidence: "Contract wording (force majeure, cancellation, refunds) goes to counsel... Whether any policy covers a given loss goes to a licensed broker."

expectations.text: Runs an interview before producing the register, asking one question at a time.
expectations.evidence: "I normally interview one question at a time. Since you need the deliverable in one pass, I used your facts and wrote down my assumptions." No interview was run.

expectations.text: Asks whether the venue contract carries a cancellation-fee schedule and requests its step-up dates and percentages verbatim.
expectations.evidence: Open question 1: "What is the venue fee schedule, verbatim? It sets the whole calendar."

expectations.text: Asks or establishes whether the event is community-run or company-run, and treats Kestrel Data as the company-run pole.
expectations.evidence: "Assumed pole: company-run."

expectations.text: Builds the register by working through a named risk taxonomy rather than brainstorming risks from a blank page.
expectations.evidence: Rows carry numbers and "(Added row.)" tags, but no named taxonomy is stated as the method.

expectations.text: Register includes organizer financial or payment-processing capability (cannot legally invoice, collect or hold money in time) as its own row.
expectations.evidence: Row 8: "Payment capability, if tickets are paid."

expectations.text: Register includes structural or commercial defection - exhibitors or sponsors abandoning the format for their own channels - as its own row, distinct from demand shortfall.
expectations.evidence: Row 14: "Exhibitor or sponsor defection to owned channels."

expectations.text: Register includes organizer discretion, the organizing group itself deciding not to run the edition with no external trigger, as its own row.
expectations.evidence: Row 15: "Organizer discretion. Budget cut, funding or strategy change pulls the plug with no external trigger."

expectations.text: Scores each risk on a 5x5 likelihood x impact matrix producing a score in the 1-25 range.
expectations.evidence: "Scale is 5×5, likelihood × impact." Scores run from 2 to 12.

expectations.text: Anchors impact against non-recoverable committed spend and reputational loss rather than schedule slip, and states that an event's date does not move so schedule risk collapses into a binary go/no-go.
expectations.evidence: It says impact is "measured against non-recoverable committed spend and reputation, not schedule slip". It never says the date doesn't move, so schedule risk collapses into go/no-go.

expectations.text: Uses four escalation bands at the boundaries Green 1-4, Yellow 5-9, Orange 10-15, Red 16-25.
Register rows carry a named owner and a review date, not just a score.
expectations.evidence: Rows have owners, but the table has no review-date column. Review is only a general statement under the table.
